# Reference titles — plumbing (distilled)

Proven titles per cluster with views (and age where recorded) and the lesson each taught. Always loaded. Performance is read against each source channel's own normal; tool-reported multiplier badges were dropped (they survive only in `archive/`). The produced titles live in `produced-log.md`; the format status they prove lives in `steering.md`.

## Table of contents
1. Roger's own winners
2. Direct faceless plumbing comps
3. Audience-overlap channels — lessons
4. Mega-pool evergreens
5. Head-to-heads (framing beats topic)

**Lessons:** drains > toilets > secrets listicles > fittings / soldering > PEX > explainers (lowest ceiling) > rough-in. The channel's normal is roughly 50k–225k with a 1M outlier; judge new uploads against that band.

## 5. Head-to-heads (framing beats topic)

1. **S-traps:** Roger's "S-Traps EXPLAINED In 10 Minutes" (lower tier) vs the comp's "The REAL Reason S-Traps Are No Longer ALLOWED In Any Home!" (411k). Same topic, several-fold uplift from forbidden-knowledge framing. Every explainer topic has a banned / REAL-reason re-attack available.
2. **Toilet clogging:** Roger's "…The Real Cause No Plumber Will Tell You" (191k) vs the comp's "…and the Free Fix No One Shows You!" (2.1M). Solution tease beat diagnosis tease; "Shows" beat "Tell"; FREE carried it. Topic ceiling proven at 2M+ — re-attacks on own topics with the higher-ceiling angle are standing strategy (produced 2026-09-07: "Why Your Toilet Keeps Clogging — and the FREE Fix No One Shows You").
3. **Toilet clogging, same channel (How To Home):** "…and the Free Fix No One Shows You!" (2.1M) vs "Why Doesn't Everyone Know This About Toilets? Never Clog Again!" (128k in 2 weeks, at the channel's normal). Solution tease plus FREE beat question-form exclusivity plus a permanence close, same channel, same topic. On the toilet topic, run the FREE-fix expression.
4. **Same persona, same fixture (Mexican Way network):** "Put a Dishwasher Tablet in Your Toilet Bowl and Watch What Happens (6 Genius Uses)" (508k in 6 days) vs "5 Toilet Cleaning Mistakes That Make Your Bathroom Smell…" (150k in 2 months). The substance "watch what happens" beat the mistakes listicle 3.4× at a tenth of the age — expect the same ordering on the 1:1 recreations.
5. **Own, Aug 2026 (Roger):** "Why Your Shower Drain Keeps Clogging — The Real Cause No Plumber Will Tell You" (79k in 4 days) vs "Vinegar vs Baking Soda vs Washing Soda vs Borax — A 45-Year Plumber Ranks All 4" (77k in 13 days). Symptom self-recognition on a universal fixture beat a substance decision — the F10×F4 template on a new fixture is the higher-ceiling move.
6. **Same channel, same count, same key (Nan Margaret):** "20 Forgotten British Nan Household Tricks That Only Poor Families Knew" (305k in 3 weeks) vs "20 Forgotten British Nan Habits Everyone Should Bring Back" (21k in 13 days). In-group exclusivity beat generic revival roughly 15×.
7. **Same title, two keys:** "13 Toxic Kitchen Items Americans Use Daily — That The Japanese Replaced for Good" (715k in 2 weeks) vs "13 Toxic Kitchen Items Americans Use Daily (Mexican Households Never Kept Them)" (268k in 8 days). The clone works; the key sets the ceiling — the reason a fourth key (German) is a real test, not a copy.
8. **Tenure claim by stake (Nan Margaret):** "I've Never Had a Bug in My House in 40 Years — The Old British Trick My Mum Swor…" (128k in 6 days) vs "I Haven't Paid a Full Electric Bill in 40 Years — The Old British Habit That Saves Me…" (19k in 2 weeks). Pest fear beat money-tenure; energy runs better as a rules listicle (F37c) than as an F2 claim.
9. **Sequel of an own winner (Bertha's Clean Home):** "The OTHER Best Way to Clean Your Shower & Tub (The Mexican Way)" (96k in 2 weeks) after the original's 1.7M in a month — a sequel pulls near the channel's normal, not the outlier.
